entities.name: Yamazaki Ansai
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yamazaki Ansai  was a Japanese philosopher and scholar. He began his career as a Buddhist monk, but eventually came to follow the teachings of Neo-Confucian Zhu Xi. He combined Neo-Confucian ideas with Shinto to create Suika Shinto.
